tracks.name: Rhythm (listeners' choice)
tracks.description: A groove where each beat of the bar is one west-to-east strip of the map; more = more and louder hits.

tracks.name: Hybrid: voices + piano + groove
tracks.description: Eight west-to-east voices carry the data; piano and a light groove underneath.

tracks.name: Ambient voices
tracks.description: Continuous panned voices, west = left, east = right; louder and brighter = more.

tracks.name: AI music (ACE-Step)
tracks.description: Music generated with ACE-Step (Apache-2.0), mixed so loudness and left/right follow the data. Pre-rendered.

tracks.name: Nature sounds
tracks.description: Sounds of what is shown (ice, fire, water, lights) over a soft chord pad.
